chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Sinan, from Ibn Miskan, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

The length of the saddle of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was one cubit, and when he performed salat, he would place it before himself and screen himself with it from anyone who might pass in front of him.

key_terms.ذِرَاعًا: a cubit, indicating the approximate length
key_terms.رَحْلِ: saddle or saddle-pack placed before the praying person

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم place a barrier in front of himself during salat?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to place his saddle in front of himself while performing salat as a screen. It indicates the practice of using a barrier before the praying person to prevent others from passing directly in front of him.
